### TUNE: Classic+ - Classic with more footstep lift. The surround and object ceilings are raised so distant steps come through louder, and the boost limiter is relaxed so close steps are no longer held back entirely.
### SELF GUN: Ultra Low - Your gun pushed to the engine's limit, 6 dB deeper than Low. NOTE: the room reflection after a shot is NOT ducked at this tier, so with the gun this far down the ring-out can become the loudest thing left.
### OUTPUT: Needs the SonicScout2.0 + (16ch) output.
